{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, removing commas
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99

# Check if any QA orders are in the 'loyal' segment
qa_loyal = df[qa_mask & (df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')]
print(f"Number of QA orders that are loyal: {len(qa_loyal)}")
print(qa_loyal[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'revenue', 'converted']])

# Now filter for loyal customers in the full dataset (before QA removal)
loyal_all = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']
print(f"Total loyal customers (including QA): {len(loyal_all)}")
print(f"Converted loyal customers (including QA): {loyal_all['converted'].sum()}")

# Drop all QA orders
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Filter for loyal customers in the clean dataset
loyal_clean = df_clean[df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']
print(f"Total loyal customers (after QA removal): {len(loyal_clean)}")
print(f"Converted loyal customers (after QA removal): {loyal_clean['converted'].sum()}")

# Compute conversion rate
clean_conversion_rate = loyal_clean['converted'].sum() / len(loyal_clean)
print(f"Conversion rate: {clean_conversion_rate:.6f}")"}
